title: Foundry begins merge-mining RSK and Fractal
summary: Foundry's first merge-mined parents appear on RSK and Fractal on the same day, in the same Bitcoin block (height 893,543), establishing a shared operational start for both attributed series.
body:
Foundry USA's first merge-mined parent on RSK and on Fractal is the same Bitcoin block: height `893,543`, mined on April 22, 2025.[^2] The pool announced Rootstock merged mining publicly, and its Fractal participation began in the same template.[^1]

That shared parent makes the opening unusually precise: this is not two loosely dated launches, but one Bitcoin template beginning both attributed series. Weekly attributions remain present on both chains throughout the following two months, showing that the opening parent began sustained activity rather than recording an isolated observation.

figures.caption: Weekly Foundry-attributed merge-mined parents across the opening nine weekly bins.
figures.accessible_summary: Foundry's first attributed RSK and Fractal parents share Bitcoin height 893,543 on April 22, 2025. Both weekly series remain active across the next two months, with RSK ranging from 266 to 323 parents and Fractal from 142 to 224 parents per weekly bin.
figures.note: Weeks start Monday; the first bin is partial because the shared first parent was mined on Tuesday 22 April. RSK uses the registered child miner address; Fractal uses independently reconciled Bitcoin parent coinbase attribution. Active, Bitcoin-target-valid events only.

references.label: Rootstock - Bitcoin Mining 2.0: Foundry Now Merge Mines Rootstock
